title: Vicar's Blessing (1089)
problem: For each enemy of the damaged creature it rolls 35%, then checks for the trait; the first holder that passes casts and the loop stops. With n holders the chance is 1 − 0.65ⁿ (2 holders: 57.75%), but never more than one cast.
notes: Community claim: Stacks despite "does not stack". Evidence: bc_ExecuteEvents L818-L826: roll @0x1410bcf5a, trait @0x1410bd139, cast @0x1410bd6f1, exit @0x1410bd790. Fix sketch: H: roll once per event, then let the first holder cast. Or T: drop "does not stack". Triage 2026-10-26: Stacks across holders (1 - 0.65^n) despite 'does not stack'. Hook: one 35% roll per event. 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Two creatures with Vicar's Blessing; over many Blight ticks the Minor Healing rate should be about 35%, not ~58%.

release_notes.intended: 35% chance to cast Minor Healing on an enemy after it takes Blight damage; does not stack.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, each holder rolled its own chance, so more holders made a cast more likely.
release_notes.fix: Now there is one 35% chance per Blight tick, however many holders there are.
